title: アンパンマンのマーチ (Anpanman no March — Anpanman's March)
description: The opening theme of the long-running anime それいけ！アンパンマン (Go! Anpanman), which has aired since 1988 and holds Guinness World Records as the anime with the most characters. Lyrics by やなせたかし (Yanase Takashi), music by 三木たかし (Miki Takashi), performed by ドリーミング (Dreaming). Despite being a children's song, the lyrics carry surprisingly deep philosophical weight: they ask 'What were you born for? What will you do with your life?' — questions Yanase wrote after reflecting on survival and sacrifice during WWII. The uplifting answer centers on love, courage, and helping others. A cultural touchstone known to every Japanese person. Vocabulary is almost entirely N5, with a few N4 words (勇気, 恐れる). Key words: 生まれる (to be born), 夢 (dream), 涙 (tears), 愛 (love), 勇気 (courage), ともだち (friend).
